## Appearance

Harris is a dashing young person with a huge, drooping pompadour and big, rolling brown eyes. He is also noted for having a most extensive and bewildering smile.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P7](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0007)_

## Personality

Harris's wife has a niece who is described as a very dashing young person.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P7](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0007)_

## History

Harris was not directly involved in the events described, but worked as a clerk in a [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) shop. [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) attempted to buy a dress for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) from him, but found Harris so intimidating that he left with rakes, seed, and sugar instead.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P3](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P7](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P33](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0033)_
